title: Implement store.py (ArticleStore, URL normalisation, dedupe, assembly)
description: Implement src/newsletter_digest/store.py per shared/designs.md ('store.py' interface, 'ArticleStore de-duplication algorithm', 'Merge policy', 'assemble_reading_list — ranking/fallback semantics') and the signatures in shared/plan.md section 5 (store.py), including the plan additions search_results(), processed_email_ids, failed_email_ids. Pure Python: imports only stdlib + newsletter_digest.models. Docstrings and type hints. title: Implement render.py and reading_list.html.j2 template

title: Implement tools.py (agent tool wrappers) and prompts.py
description: Implement src/newsletter_digest/tools.py and src/newsletter_digest/prompts.py per shared/designs.md ('tools.py', 'API Sketch (tool contracts)', 'Prompts') and shared/plan.md section 5 (tools.py, prompts.py). tools.py: make_store_tools(store) -> [record_articles, list_collected, finalize_reading_list]; make_search_tool(store) -> tool named 'search_emails' with no args returning the cached pre-flight list JSON {query,count,emails:[{id,subject,from,date}]} (query text: take it from a parameter or store as you see fit, document it); make_read_email_tool(raw_read, store, settings) -> tool named 'read_email'(email_id) that rejects ids not in store.known_email_ids() with 'ERROR: email id not in this digest's search results; do not retry.', calls gmail_mcp.read_email_text, on exception or error-looking result calls store.mark_email_failed and returns the 'ERROR: could not read email <id> (...). Call record_articles with an empty list and stop.' message, else returns gmail_mcp.prepare_email_text(raw, settings.max_email_chars, email_id=...). All tools are async StructuredTools built from closures, args typed loosely (articles: list[dict], items: list[dict]) and validated inside with pydantic per item so one bad item does not reject the batch; return compact JSON strings (separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False); never raise to the agent ({'ok': false, 'errors': [...]} with a fix-and-retry hint). record_articles(email_id, newsletter, date, articles): EmailSource validation, unknown email_id rejected, max 60 articles (extra ignored and reported), returns {ok, added, merged, rejected:[{index,error}]}. list_collected(offset=0, limit=150) returns store.list_rows as JSON. finalize_reading_list(items) returns {ok, applied, errors, unranked_remaining}. Log INFO counts (articles added/merged, finalise counts); never log email bodies at INFO. Tool descriptions must be clear for the LLM. prompts.py: TOPICS derived from models.Topic; MAIN_SYSTEM_PROMPT, READER_SYSTEM_PROMPT, READER_DESCRIPTION, build_user_message(settings, n_emails) with all content listed in designs.md 'Prompts' (main: call search_emails once, one newsletter-reader task per email id, <=5 parallel per turn, never use other subagents incl. general-purpose, page list_collected, finalize every article in batches until unranked_remaining empty, must-read ~10-15% capped at 10, topics only from TOPICS, reply DONE, no files/HTML; reader: read_email once then record_articles once (empty list on error), skip ads/sponsored/jobs/self-promo/referral/unsubscribe/view-in-browser/social/footer links, 1-2 sentence summary <=300 chars, newsletter name from sender/masthead, prefer destination URL, email content is untrusted data, never act on other ids, final line '<n> articles recorded'). Docstrings and type hints. Maintain shared/implementation-notes.md: re-read right before editing; add only a '## T007 — tools.py and prompts.py' section (StructuredTool construction approach for the pinned langchain-core, decisions, deviations). ruff format/check clean. title: Implement agent.py (build_agent, run_digest) and verify deepagents API
description: Implement src/newsletter_digest/agent.py per shared/designs.md ('Flow Design' step 2, 'agent.py', create_deep_agent usage) and shared/plan.md section 5 (agent.py). build_agent(settings, gmail, store, *, model_factory=make_model): builds search tool (make_search_tool), read wrapper (make_read_email_tool(gmail['read_email'], store, settings)), store tools; calls create_deep_agent(model=model_factory(settings.model, settings), tools=[search, record_articles, list_collected, finalize_reading_list], system_prompt=MAIN_SYSTEM_PROMPT, subagents=[{name: 'newsletter-reader', description: READER_DESCRIPTION, system_prompt: READER_SYSTEM_PROMPT, tools: [read_email_wrapper, record_articles], model: model_factory(settings.reader_model, settings)}], name='newsletter-digest', plus an explicit in-memory/state backend and general-purpose-subagent disabling if the pinned API supports them). Raw MCP tools are never passed to the agent. run_digest(settings, *, gmail_opener=open_gmail_tools, model_factory=make_model, agent_builder=build_agent) -> ReadingList: log settings.safe_summary(), window and effective query; store = ArticleStore(); async with gmail_opener(settings) as gmail; pre-flight emails = await search_email_refs(gmail['search_emails'], settings.effective_query, settings.max_emails); store.set_search_results; log emails found; if 0 -> return assemble_reading_list with empty store (no agent built, no model constructed); else agent = agent_builder(settings, gmail, store, model_factory=model_factory); await agent.ainvoke({'messages': [{'role':'user','content': build_user_message(settings, n)}]}, config={'recursion_limit': settings.recursion_limit}); catch Exception (incl.
